description: Get the phone number connected to the authenticated user's account in E.164 format, along with its caller_id_status (verified or unverified). With the phone workspace enabled, this resolves the default outbound number and also returns source_number_id; it may be a verified personal caller ID or an owned Patch number. Use list_phone_numbers to see available sources. Takes no arguments and does not place a call.
name: get_phone_number

phone_number.description: Authenticated account caller ID in E.164 format.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.
